items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then, when Art Farmer left Horace Silver’s, Horace used to me because I knew his music, me and Clifford Jordan. Clifford Jordan and I were the front line.

ctx.x: See, I know him as a piano player.

Yeah, I know. But he lost a lung like I did and he went to piano. You know Horace Silver as a piano player. He was a saxophone player. He came up with Paul Gonsalves. They were both on the same level. Kenny Dorham played saxophone. In those days, if you didn’t play multi instruments, you didn’t work. To get into one of those bands, the old diamonds, you had to be a multiple instrument player. There’s one other thing before I skip over Kai completely, before I get over that. To me, he’s one of the most, and will…
The pocket squares and the whole nine.
